summary: DX747 turns the FM-1 into an eight-part multitimbral DX7-style FM sound module, meant to be played over MIDI. It replaces the sequencer, sampler and drums.
features: Eight parts on any MIDI channels, 16 voices shared
Up to eight DX7 voices layered per part, with key and velocity windows
64 scenes, recalled from keys, buttons or program change
DIN, USB and Bluetooth MIDI in; DX7 SysEx voice editing
128 factory voices, DX7 cartridge import, master filter, reverb and delay
USB audio out; no sequencer, can't read other firmwares' projects

headings: dx747: an eight-part multitimbral dx7 module for the m-vave fm-1
